verdict.rationale: telli's own docs say it has built-in metric tracking for reach rate, call duration and success rate, and per-call analysis of transcripts and outcome fields, so no self-built analytics is needed. Sentiment analysis is never mentioned, and the dashboard views are described only in brief one-line docs. missing for 10: sentiment analytics, detailed documentation of dashboard views and outcome aggregation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
